items.title: News Corp (NASDAQ:NWSA) Reports Bullish Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Global media and publishing company News Corp (NASDAQ:NWSA) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.8% year on year to $2.34 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.35 per share was 51.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
